cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

mechanism: A absorbs B machine-operation clues while calmly presenting the newly learned steps as corrections from the only qualified coffee maker.
confusable: D18 can fake expertise without learning; here each B clue must visibly change A procedure while A maintains familiar confidence.
comparison: Tent alternative learns component order through physical corrections; coffee alternative learns hidden controls and serving selection.
seedUse: Steam button, hidden flap and two-cup dial derive from D42-a; S03 adds precise operation and serving corrections based on B clues.
